rationale: Addresses critical evaluation feedback by removing billed_amount and allowed_amount from features to eliminate target leakage of post-submission settlement information. These fields encode decisions made after claim submission and are unavailable at prediction time, causing inflated model performance (ROC-AUC > 0.99). Adding model_limitations caveat communicates that the early-warning model is a baseline screening tool with inherent limitations and should not be used as a standalone decision mechanism. Maintains dual-model comparison (logistic regression and random forest) with training-only preprocessing and threshold computation to preserve statistical rigor.
changes_summary: Removed billed_amount and allowed_amount from feature_set to eliminate target leakage of post-submission settlement information that inflated model performance. Added model_limitations caveat to write_report to transparently communicate the model's role as a baseline screening tool and its inherent limitations.
